what_its_for: Sildenafil is used to treat two conditions. Under the brand name Viagra, it helps men get and keep an erection when they want to have sex. Under the brand name Revatio, it is used to treat pulmonary arterial hypertension (high blood pressure in the lungs), which can make it easier to exercise and breathe.
how_to_take: Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. You can take it with or without food. However, eating a large, high-fat meal before taking it may slow down how quickly it works. Do not crush or chew the tablet unless your doctor tells you to.
dosing: For erectile dysfunction (Viagra): The usual starting dose is 50 mg taken about 1 hour before sexual activity. Your doctor may adjust your dose to 25 mg or 100 mg based on how well it works for you and any side effects. Do not take more than one dose in a 24-hour period. For pulmonary hypertension (Revatio): The usual dose is 20 mg taken three times a day, about 4 to 6 hours apart. Always follow your doctor's specific instructions, as your dose may be different.
missed_dose: For erectile dysfunction: This medicine is taken only when needed, so a regular dosing schedule does not apply. Just take it before sexual activity as directed. For pulmonary hypertension: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store sildenafil at room temperature, between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C). Keep it away from heat, moisture, and direct light. Do not store it in the bathroom. Keep all medicines out of reach of children and pets. Do not use the medication after the expiration date printed on the package.
what_to_avoid: Do not take sildenafil if you are taking any nitrate medicines, such as nitroglycerin, isosorbide, or recreational drugs called 'poppers' (amyl nitrate or butyl nitrate). Combining these can cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit, as it can increase the level of sildenafil in your blood and raise your risk of side effects. Limit alcohol, as it can lower blood pressure and may make side effects like dizziness worse. Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery if you feel dizzy or have vision changes after taking this medicine.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away or go to the emergency room if you experience: an erection that lasts longer than 4 hours (priapism), as this is a medical emergency and can permanently damage the penis; sudden vision loss in one or both eyes; sudden hearing loss or ringing in your ears; chest pain, irregular heartbeat, or feeling faint during or after sex; severe dizziness or fainting; a severe allergic reaction, including rash, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, or difficulty breathing. Also contact your doctor if you notice any side effects that bother you or do not go away, such as flushing, headache, upset stomach, or stuffy nose.
when_it_works: For erectile dysfunction: Sildenafil usually starts working within 30 to 60 minutes after you take it. It works best when you are sexually aroused. The effects can last for up to 4 to 6 hours. For pulmonary hypertension: It may take several weeks of regular dosing before you notice improvements in your ability to exercise and breathe more easily. Keep taking it as prescribed, even if you feel well.
special_populations: Older adults (over 65): Your doctor may start you on a lower dose because the medicine may stay in your body longer. Kidney or liver problems: Your doctor may adjust your dose if you have kidney or liver disease. Women and children: Viagra (sildenafil for erectile dysfunction) is only approved for use in adult men. Revatio may be prescribed for certain adults and children with pulmonary hypertension, but only under close medical supervision. Pregnancy and breastfeeding: Talk to your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding.
